recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成熟中的紅血球母細胞很少，卻可見少數大型、核大而染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性的早期細胞（疑似巨大原紅血球），背景有細長的鐮刀型紅血球與纖維蛋白絲；鐮刀型貧血患者出現紅系造血中斷，指向微小病毒 B19 引起的再生不良危象。
features: Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors (polychromatic/orthochromatic normoblasts)
Occasional large immature cells with large oval nuclei, fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of giant pronormoblasts
Mixed background of lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and granulocytes
Elongated pale sickle-shaped red cells in the background
Pink fibrin strands and smudged cells (hemodilute, partially clotted aspirate)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute with fibrin strands and smudged cells. There is a striking paucity of maturing normoblasts, while occasional large immature cells with large nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm are present, compatible with early/giant pronormoblasts. The remaining cells include lymphocytes, plasma cells and granulocytes, and sickled red cells are seen in the background. Viral inclusions cannot be confirmed at this resolution. In a patient with sickle cell disease, findings are consistent with erythroid maturation arrest due to aplastic crisis, most likely parvovirus B19; confirmation by B19 PCR and reticulocytopenia is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemia shows sheets of blasts or proerythroblasts, whereas aplastic crisis has only scattered giant pronormoblasts and recovers within 1-2 weeks.

ddx.dx: Acquired pure red cell aplasia (thymoma, autoimmune)
ddx.vs: Chronic PRCA shows absent erythroid precursors without giant pronormoblasts and without evidence of acute B19 infection.

ddx.dx: Megaloblastic crisis (folate deficiency) in hemolytic anemia
ddx.vs: Folate deficiency shows abundant megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes rather than erythroid depletion.
Sequestration shows a brisk reticulocytosis with active marrow erythropoiesis, not erythroid aplasia.
